schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acp_application_preferences (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), settings_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(settings_json) AND length(CAST(settings_json AS BLOB))<=262144));
read: SELECT settings_json FROM acp_application_preferences WHERE id=1
write: INSERT INTO acp_application_preferences(id,settings_json) VALUES(1,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET settings_json=excluded.settings_json

legacyInstructions.merge:
WITH sources AS (
        SELECT CAST(key AS INTEGER) AS position, value ->> 'label' AS label, value ->> 'content' AS content
        FROM json_each(?)
    ), unique_sources AS (
        SELECT label, content FROM sources GROUP BY content ORDER BY MIN(position)
    )
    SELECT CASE count(*) WHEN 1 THEN max(content)
      ELSE group_concat('## ' || label || char(10,10) || content, char(10,10)) END
    FROM unique_sources
